# RX Tracker NEXT v4.0.0-next.80

## Changed

- Adds a guarded rerun of the improved structured-address cleanup for
  already-populated databases.
- Preserves the legacy full Address field for review and updates only the new
  Address / Street, City, State, and ZIP fields.
- Keeps existing manual structured address corrections when the old full
  Address text remains ambiguous.
- Accepts either `City:` or `Region:` labels in patient CSV imports for
  regional Patient Tags after the group rename.

## Database

- Adds audited migration
  `20260906000000-rerun-improved-structured-address-cleanup.js`.
- Works with the existing regional reassignment migration: Tampa-region cities
  map to Tampa, populated non-Tampa cities map to Miami, and no-address
  patients map to None.

## Fresh Dump Validation

- Restored `production-backup-new-2.dump` only into isolated database
  `patient_rx_test_copy_new2_20260906`.
- Migrated to 60 applied migrations, 0 pending migrations, and a verified
  checksum ledger.
- Structured City/State coverage increased from 2857 to 3086 patients.
- ZIP coverage increased from 2831 to 3026 patients.
- Forty ambiguous rows still have address text but no reliable City and remain
  manual; 423 no-address patients remain Region/City None.
- Confirmed no street-fragment City values remained after cleanup.

## Safety

- No proxy, VPN, FortiGate, cookie, `.env`, port, `rxUrl()`, service
  bootstrap, user, RX Action, or RX workflow configuration change is included.

## Validation

- `npm run test:patient-address-parser`
- `npm run test:patient-import-address-tags`
- `npm run db:verify` on `patient_rx_dev`
- `npm run db:verify` on `patient_rx_test_copy_new2_20260906`
- `npm run check:public-js`
- `node --check` for touched parser, importer, migration, and regression tests
